 Versus

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Present:-
Mr. Rajat Mittal, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. V.S. Rawat, A.G.A. for the State.

Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Fir No. 42 of 2023, under Sections 417, 376, 506 Ipc, Police
Station Lakshman Jhula, District Pauri Garhwal.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicant's and the informant's marriage proposal was underway.

It is during that period the applicant and the informant visited various places where, as per the FIR, the applicant established physical relations with the informant under the assurance that very soon they would be getting married.
Subsequently, the applicant declined to marry the informant.
The FIR is quite in detail.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that it was a consensual relationship.
It is not a case of rape.
No offence, as such, is made out.
It is argued that the Court had granted ad-interim anticipatory bail to the applicant and now charge sheet has been filed.
5. Learned State counsel would submit that the victim has supported the prosecution case during investigation.
6. Having considered the entirety of facts, this Court is of the view that this is a case fit for anticipatory bail. 7
The anticipatory bail application is allowed.

10. In the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be enlarged on anticipatory bail, subject to his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties, each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court Kunal Bhakat vs State Of Uttarakhand on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106756666/
1 concerned.

sentences.text:
In addition to it, the applicant shall also comply with the following conditions:
(i) The applicant shall not approach any witness in any manner, whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) The applicant shall deposit his passport with the court concerned.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the court concerned.
(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), & (ii) above.
